episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: The short film for Operation Beckoning Cat helped spread awareness of the town revitalization event, but the exceptional response raises the bar significantly, troubling Muni. To repay everyone's gratitude, Lyrical Lily takes the lead for the next stage. While they work hard on a new song with the theme of March, all units get together to enjoy the Doll Festival.

episodes.synopsis: Maho is absent from the usual after school gathering. As they prepare for the next live show, the day begins on a strange note. episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Photon Maiden is steadily working on a new song for Operation Beckoning Cat. However, Saki tells the members that she feels they need a new and different color. Noa, in agreement, gathers the rest and proposes writing a new song immediately. With Towa's help, she presents the idea of a ""self-introduction song"" to showcase their true selves.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis:
二つのユニットメンバーの個々の色、輝きを見た咲姫は美夢と星空の下で語り合い、晴れやかな朝を迎えていた。

そして今月招き猫作戦のステージを担当するPhoton MaidenはLyricalLilyに合同ライブのお誘いをする。

実りある合宿で新曲のイメージが出来た咲姫。

街がハロウィンで賑わう中、荘厳な星空ステージが幕を開ける。

related.plot: Rinku Aimoto, studentessa trasferita alla Yoba Academy, incontra il DJ in formazione Maho Akashi. Vedendo che Rinku è interessata alle attività di DJ, Maho la porta a vedere l'esibizione della più popolare unità di DJ della scuola, Peaky P-key. Consumata dall'eccitazione della performance, Rinku chiede a Maho di formare con lei un'unità di DJ
